instance_description:
Setting: During 2026, this instance covers a part-time public-horticulture certificate delivered through community-college classes, a teaching greenhouse, and local field sites.
Scope: Recurring areas include coursework planning, supervised sessions, plant observations, practical examinations, group projects, research, advising, credential progress, and education expenses.
Resources: Reusable records track learning items, scheduled sessions, and completion requirements; blank files support observation notes, assignment drafting, and communications; a personal wallet handles authorized costs.
Exclusions: It excludes employment, household administration, leisure gardening without a learning objective, official college systems, instructor decisions, classmates’ private data, and independent professional horticultural work.
personal_description:
Identity: Leona Marwick is an adult learner enrolled throughout 2026 in a part-time public-horticulture certificate at a community college and its teaching greenhouse.
Responsibilities: She manages coursework, supervised greenhouse and field sessions, plant-observation records, practical assessments, group work, advising steps, and completion evidence alongside personal commitments.
Authority: Leona may organize her study, prepare and submit her own materials, book permitted student services, contact instructors, and make personal education purchases.
Restrictions: She cannot change official grades, authorize classmates’ choices, access restricted records, perform unsupervised hazardous treatments, or claim instructor approval; privacy and academic-integrity rules apply.
